senses.gloss: f. <cite ref="E00909">same</cite>, <he>הֲשָׁבַת אבידה</he> the duty of restoring a neighbor’s lost property.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 5:7">B. Kam. V, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 54b">54ᵇ</cite>) <he>לה׳ א׳</he> (Ms. M. a. Y. ed. <he>להָשֵׁיב</he>; Y. ib. V, end, 5ᵃ <he>להָשֵׁב</he>, v. <cite ref="E00909">preced.</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 281:2">Yalk. Ex. 281</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>הֲשָׁבוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 57a:12">B. Kam. 57ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 31a:14">B. Mets. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני … ריבתה ה׳ הרבה</he> because the Biblical text speaks frequently of restoration (but does nos intimate that the owner must be notified of the restoration).
